\newcommand{\visibleintro}{%
Flaky tests pass and fail on the same code without any change to the program under test.
This study runs each test of 26 open-source Java projects one hundred times and records
every outcome together with the order in which the tests ran.}
\newcommand{\visibleresults}{%
The detector labels 450 of 533 tests as stable, 51 as flaky, and 32 as unclear. A manual
check of the flaky tests confirms 47 of the 51 labels, and the remaining four tests depend
on the system clock.}
